posts.caption: Sunday up at Craggy. Rhododendron mostly done, blueberries not quite ripe. Back at the bench by 4 this morning like nothing happened.
Got to the market early enough for the @marshandmill peach galettes. Two came home with me, one is already gone. 🍑
First weekend of the fall menu at @marshandmill. Pumpkin loaf and cider donuts in the case and a line out the door by 9:30. Worth it. 🍂 #westasheville
My own pumpkin loaf, after a week of eating @marshandmill's. Still too hot to slice and I have zero patience.

PSA for the neighborhood: @marshandmill Thanksgiving pies are open. Apple, pecan, pumpkin and a bourbon sweet potato, pickup the Wednesday before Thanksgiving. Message them soon, they stop when the oven schedule is full. 🥧 📷 @marshandmill #westasheville
Sunday haul from @marshandmill: rye still warm from the oven and three cider donuts for the walk home 🍩
Living vicariously through @marshandmill at the big artisan baking expo in Chicago this week. Forty baguettes shaped in ten minutes, apparently. I can barely shape one. 📷 from their story
A green dinosaur on guard over seven candles' worth of chocolate. Picked up at the market this morning, now on to a very important party. 🦖

Day one at the North American Artisan Baking Expo. Watched a baker shape forty baguettes in the time it takes me to shape six. I have three pages of notes for the team already. Café is closed Monday and Tuesday as always, and I'm back at the bench Wednesday.
Blueberry hand pies at the North Asheville market until noon. Happy Fourth. #marketsaturday #avleats
Peach galettes 🍑
round 2 lets go 📚
Rye, this morning.
Fall menu starts today. Apple cider donuts on Saturday and Sunday only, pumpkin loaf every day we're open. What should we add next?

Thanksgiving pie preorders are open. Apple, pecan, pumpkin, and a bourbon sweet potato we're pretty proud of. Pickup Wed 11/25 at the cafe. Message the page to order.
